summary.text: Brett Lindstrom is a financial adviser and former Republican state senator from Omaha who finished third in the 2022 Republican primary for governor. His platform, the 'Nebraska Doctrine,' focuses on property-tax changes, housing, public power, economic development and artificial intelligence policy.

paragraphs.text: B.S. in history from the University of Nebraska–Lincoln (2004); walk-on quarterback for the Cornhuskers; has worked as a financial adviser in Omaha.
Represented the 18th District in the Nebraska Legislature from 2015 to 2023; ran in the 2012 Republican primary for Nebraska's 2nd Congressional District.
Announced a run for the 2nd District in July 2025 and withdrew in January 2026, then ran for governor as a nonpartisan before filing as the America First nominee.
